title: 構造力学Ⅱ
subtitle: Structural Mechanics II
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1)　learn the strength and stress-strain relationship of materials.
(2)　learn about the sectional moment of inertia and moment of inertia area.
(3)　learn how to estimate flexural and shear stresses in beams.
(4)　learn how to estimate axial forces in trusses.
(5)　learn how to estimate axial force in short columns and buckling loads of long columns.
advice:
This is the second basic structural mechanics course. We will cover the following topics:

1. Stress and strain
2. Sectional moment of inertia and moment of inertia area
3. Stress in structural members
4. Estimating shear stress and flexural stress in beam members
5. Axial forces in truss structures
6. Stresses in short columns and the cross-sectional core
7. Buckling of long columns

These concepts are often used in structural design. Students should gain a deep understanding of this material. The concepts are also useful in studying Structural Design, Project Design, Reinforced Concrete and Structural Design Practice.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is the second basic structural mechanics course. We will cover the following topics:

1. Stress and strain
2. Sectional moment of inertia and moment of inertia area
3. Stress in structural members
4. Estimating shear stress and flexural stress in beam members
5. Axial forces in truss structures
6. Stresses in short columns and the cross-sectional core
7. Buckling of long columns

These concepts are often used in structural design. Students should gain a deep understanding of this material. The concepts are also useful in studying Structural Design, Project Design, Reinforced Concrete and Structural Design Practice.
